prompts.poster:

Remove ALL existing game UI: top and side status boxes, minimap, buttons, weapon bar, numbers, floating health bars, nameplates, notifications, Chinese instruction overlays. Reconstruct only the small areas occluded by the UI consistently with adjacent existing pixels. Do NOT upgrade the models into realistic military soldiers, do NOT invent spaceships, buildings, turrets or other gameplay.
Create a polished promotional layout from this screenshot: crop tightly enough that the huge insect at the gate, defending blue soldier, and crowded insect attack remain prominent. Strong readable silhouettes. Retain gameplay-looking rendering. Slightly deepen the shadows with dark navy/teal while keeping the sandy terrain and warm yellow-orange eyes and gunfire; do not radically repaint the game.
A restrained navy title area near the upper left with very large bold, clean simplified Chinese text exactly "虫潮围城", warm ivory letters with subtle golden edge; only these four Chinese characters, no subtitles, no slogans, no version, no website, no watermark. Keep all four characters beautifully legible. Professional game listing cover, fill the entire 4:3 canvas with no letterbox and no rounded corners. The real battle should occupy most of the image. Avoid overdecorated HUD-like frames.
prompts.icon:
